class.name: TerrainBrush3D
class.brief_description: A circle or rectangle height brush for [TerrainDeformer3D]: craters, building plots, road beds.
class.description: Lowers, raises, flattens or offsets the ground to this node's global height, inside its [member shape] and over a soft [member falloff] band around it. Follows the node's position, rotation around Y and scale. Add it to a [TerrainDeformer3D]'s [member TerrainDeformer3D.brushes]; moving it re-applies the deformer.

method.name: get_carve_brush
method.description: The brush as [TerrainDeformer3D] reads it: [code]rect[/code], [code]cell_size[/code], [code]size[/code], [code]heights[/code], [code]mask[/code] and [code]mode[/code]. Empty when disabled.

members.member: Spacing of the brush's height samples, in metres. Keep it at or below the ground's vertex spacing.

How far below this node's height the target sits. With [constant PROFILE_BOWL] it is the depth at the centre, falling to [code]0[/code] at the edge. With [constant MODE_ADD] it is the offset subtracted from the ground.
If [code]false[/code], the brush carves nothing and the ground under it is restored.
Width of the soft band outside the shape, in metres, over which the brush blends into the ground (smoothstep).
How the target combines with the ground.
Circle (an ellipse when [member size] differs on its axes) or rectangle.
Width (local X) and length (local Z) of the shape, in metres, before the falloff band.

signal.name: carve_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the brush moves or a property changes.

constants.constant: Cuts the ground down to the target, never raises it.
Builds the ground up to the target, never lowers it.
Sets the ground to the target.
Offsets the ground by minus [member depth].
A target [member depth] deep at the centre, rising to this node's height at the edge.
